# One-Page Marketing Plan

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @wondelai. Discovered via skills.sh. Turns a scattered pile of marketing tactics into one living page: a 3×3 grid covering the full customer journey — BEFORE (target market, message, media), DURING (capture leads, nurture, convert), AFTER (world-class experience, lifetime value, referrals) — with a 10-point scoring discipline that only counts a square when it's specific and measurable, plus worked templates and examples. Honest notes: a planning framework, not market research — it can't tell you which media your audience actually consumes or what competitors really charge; the PVP Index niche-picking is opinionated (personal fulfillment counts as much as profitability — adjust to your appetite); its strength is forcing specificity, which only works if you fill the squares honestly. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
